title: feat(research): combine quadratic twiddle time with compact tapes
body:
## Summary

The supplied unary program in PR3534 charged O(p²) cells. The canonical circuit's written binary-program simulation charged O(p² log(p+2)) work. This package combines O(p²) executed header work with O(p log(p+2)) charged cells on five fixed tape roles, under the same source bands.

```text
borrowed binary program + borrowed physical address
  load canonical binary operand
  decrement, shorten top marker, detect zero locally
  read wire, return head, erase counter
  evaluate circuit, emit header, erase wires, return borrowed heads
```

The all-finite-program proof derives exact access cost `F(w)=8h(w)+27+17w-5popcount(w)` and the complete read/write/unit-move and allocation formulas. Normalizing the counter removes the full-width zero scan at each step. The executable caps its domain at 4,096 wires and 200,000 program symbols.

## Evidence

- **Before:** The retained PR3534 formula gives 211,847 program cells and 212,526 total cells for the same ell=48 circuit.
  **After:** The compact machine executes 4,180,246 primitives with 7,608 program cells and 8,300 total cells. These are exact model counts, not CPU timing or a strict saving for every small circuit.
- Every index from 0 through 1,023 passes an independent access invoice and restoration check. All 1,412 synthetic headers across 52 programs and 365 generic/borrow-chain cases across 53 programs match independent output and complete invoice oracles. Fourteen malformed/resource cases reject.
- At publication head `985f599442bb386e848a51c82277300f61ffd7e0`, registered CPython 3.12 replay, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history checks and scoped Ruff pass. Normal and optimized science plus eight actual optimized CLI fault groups and a valid retry pass from the committed Git-free export. All 17 export files and 16 corresponding source files retain their bytes, modes and identities.

```sh
TMPDIR=/absolute/private/run python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/compact-twiddle-tapes
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/compact-twiddle-tapes --check-source-history
```

README supplies direct and export replay commands. SOURCES.json pins the canonical circuit runtime, its actual proof premise and the retained transform source at main `20ecf289`. The unary comparison's exact pending-predecessor bytes and origin are retained separately in COMPARISONS.json and comparisons/. Scientific replay needs no foreign Git objects or network.

The program and address remain supplied. Encoding, host admission/allocation/instrumentation and final observation are outside the primitive invoice. Encoded shape/topology production, address enumeration, signed packet/layer consumption and the complete native/root/ordinary/hosting caller remain open. No supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

Credit Nick Petalas's PR3522 circuit/proof and PR3534 unary comparison, Philipp/mightyOil, Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, Douglas Colkitt and the retained Nussbaumer/Quandalle and Harvey/van der Hoeven source lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way.

**Blast Radius:** Research.

Adds one isolated opt-in package. Frozen inputs and selected construction are unchanged.
